meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: Claude 会用 Dask 编写 Python 代码,把超过内存的数据拆成小块并行处理;DataFrame、Array 等操作先搭建任务图,调用 compute() 才真正算出结果,还能在多核或集群上运行。
howto.when: 当数据超出内存、需要把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到集群,或要并行处理多个文件时触发。

say.text: 我的数据太大装不进内存,帮我用 Dask 读 CSV 并算分组均值。
say.note: 会生成 Dask 代码,最后用 compute() 出结果。

say.text: 把这段 pandas 脚本改成 Dask 版本,保持同样逻辑。
say.note: Claude 会改写为惰性执行并加 compute()。

howto.what_en: Claude writes Python/Dask code that chunks out-of-memory data for parallel processing; DataFrame and Array operations build a task graph, then compute() actually executes, across cores or a cluster.
howto.when_en: Triggered when data exceeds available RAM, when existing pandas/NumPy code needs to scale beyond memory or across clusters, or when processing multiple files in parallel.

say_en.text: My data is too big for RAM; use Dask to read CSVs and compute group means.
say_en.note: Generates Dask code that finishes with compute().

say_en.text: Convert this pandas script to Dask while keeping the same logic.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites it as lazy execution with compute().
